name: Keturah
overview: Scripture reveals Keturah as a wife or concubine of Abraham, whom he took after the death of Sarah. She bore him six sons—Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah—who became ancestors of various peoples. The genealogies of her descendants, including Jokshan’s sons Sheba and Dedan and Midian’s sons Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah, emphasize the continuation of Abraham’s covenantal blessings through multiple lines.
